comment: v2 spec §3.3; sun, sky-fill (ambientSky) and shade tints from the lighting bible (look-fix-v1 §2.2-2.3: morning, midday = noon, golden hour, blue hour = dawn/dusk, moon night = night; night sky #404F7A horizon to #232A50 above, §2.4) since 2026-10-06; clear-day sky gradients (skyTop, skyHorizon) moved toward the bible's concept images (lighting-01 to -05, sky-03; the spec gives no sky numbers) the same day. exposure (engine addition, noon = 0.58 relative to the tuned light scale; night 1.6, dawn/dusk 1.5 since 2026-10-06 so dark materials stay readable at night) scales all scene light before tone mapping so a high noon sun does not clip pale paving; v2 says sunIntensity is not an exposure. Keys are interpolated by sun elevation and rising/setting, never by clock time. sunIntensity is normalized (noon = 1). Anchors: dawn −4° rising, morning +15° rising, noon at the day's maximum, golden hour +6° setting, dusk −4° setting, night below −12°.

fill.comment: R8: sky fill 0.20–0.35 of the noon key, ground bounce 0.06–0.12
